typography.guidelines: Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use Manrope for clear numerical displays. Keep tracking tight on headings. All font loading should be handled via Expo (@expo-google-fonts/manrope).

bill_card.structure: Flat, 1px border. No drop shadow. Rounded-2xl (16px radius). Flex row for left/right split (Name/Date vs Amount). Padding: 16px.

bottom_tab_bar.style: Fixed bottom, bg-surface, border-t border-border. height: 64px minimum.
bottom_tab_bar.icons: Use @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons). Active state: accent color. Inactive: text_secondary.

fab.style: Absolute bottom-6 right-6. 56x56px. Circle (rounded-full). bg-accent. icon: Plus (white). Elevation/shadow-sm. Must have data-testid='fab-add-bill'.

buttons.primary: bg-accent text-white rounded-xl h-12 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-base min-h-[44px]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-text_primary rounded-xl h-12 flex items-center justify-center font-semibold text-base min-h-[44px]

inputs.style: h-14 rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface px-4 text-base focus:border-accent min-h-[44px]

segmented_filters.style: Flex row, bg-border p-1 rounded-xl min-h-[44px]
segmented_filters.active: bg-surface shadow-sm rounded-lg text-text_primary font-semibold py-2 px-4

Home.layout: Header: 'Total Due' massive (text-4xl, tight tracking). Scrollable list of 'Upcoming Bills'. Overdue items explicitly highlighted at the top. FAB to quick add.

Bills.layout: Top sticky segmented control (All | Paid | Unpaid). Scrollable FlatList. Sort button top right (Date arrow).

AddEditBill.layout: Form layout. Name (input), Amount (large numeric input), Due Date (system picker), Recurring toggle (Switch/Segmented - None, Weekly, Monthly), Notes (multiline). Save button sticky at bottom.

Stats.layout: Two massive cards at top: Total Paid, Total Spent This Month. Below: Simple list grouping by category/month or simple progress bar of paid vs unpaid.

Settings.layout: List layout. Theme Toggle (Light/Dark/System). Currency Picker ($, ₹, €). Auth Section: Google/Facebook buttons (UI only). About row.

empty_states.instructions: Do not use placeholder image URLs. Use @expo/vector-icons like 'Receipt' or 'Wallet' at size 64px, color text_secondary.

testing.instructions: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='add-bill-button'. Follow role-based naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind via NativeWind or standard StyleSheet mapping exactly to the colors and 8pt scale provided in this JSON.
Implement light and dark mode respecting system preference by default.
Do NOT use heavy shadows, keep UI flat (1px borders).
Minimum touch targets must be 44px height for all inputs and buttons.
Use Manrope font loaded via Expo Google Fonts.
Use @expo/vector-icons for all icons (Ionicons preferred for Android feel).
Include seed logic to generate 3-4 bills on first launch so the UI is not empty.
Implement local notifications logic (even if mocked initially) for due bills.
